title: Caught!

Police takedowns can be risky business, especially when criminals are armed and dangerous; that's why officers rely on non-lethal tactics like tasers, bean bag rounds, and K-9 units to subdue suspects when things get a little too close for comfort.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers

S01 E01 — Twister Shapeshifter
Near Gary, S.D., expert chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot an encounter with a long-track, shape-shifting tornado; when the twister takes a turn towards an occupied farmhouse, chasers are thrust into the role of first responders.

S01 E02 — Mile-Wide EF5
Six teams of chasers pursue a violent tornado outbreak in North Dakota; but as day turns to night, the storm unleashes the first EF5 tornado in over a decade; as the mile-wide monster levels homes and farms, chasers race to rescue people and pets.

Josh needs a Hail Mary to save his season; Bryce, fighting to maintain his lead, faces difficulties in a race about speed; still reeling from his relationship drama, AJ is determined to prove himself in the final races of the Mud Cup.

title: Mud Madness
description:
S02 E08 — The $100,000 Controversy
It's the final race of the Mud Cup and four drivers are fighting for the $100,000 prize; a shocking controversy has thrown the championship into question, stunning the entire mud world.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E02 — Stranger Danger
Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E03 — Mine and Shine
Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E04 — Digger Knows Best
Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E09 — Mutiny At TTC
Tensions run high on the streets of Las Vegas as the year comes to a close; Elmer has a blowout with his boss; Pineapple rips into a new driver over their worst tow ever; Nick deals with a raging customer.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E05 — Heartbreak Hotel
The crazies on the Strip keep the tow bros busy; TW goes toe-to-toe with an angry Elvis, and Jeremy contends with salty strip club clients while Pineapple senses déjà vu in a trucker's lot; Elmer is sent on a fool's errand.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E04 — Tricks, Treats, and Tows
A drunk man dressed like a giant baby refuses to let Shawn tow his car; a frightening find spooks Pineapple; during a call at a haunted house, the tow truck driver is terrified.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E08 — Formula One Frenzy
It's a race for the most tows as thousands of fans descend on Las Vegas for the Formula One Grand Prix; TW subdues a raunchy party while Shawn confronts a racegoer carrying a big wrench; Elmer's frustrations with The Tow Truck Company come to a head.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E07 — Bachelorette Brawl
The ladies of Vegas give the tow truck drivers a run for their money when Pineapple fends off a bevy of bachelorettes in a bus; Kyle encounters a showgirl; Shawn faces off with Goliath and scores are settled between the tow companies.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E05 — Copy Cat
Officers get intelligence on a passenger heading to London carrying an illicit load; when questioned, the man says he's meeting with Braveheart; a shipment of high-end construction equipment throws up red flags when its quality looks shoddy.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E06 — Does Not Compute
Officers inspect an old computer that looks like it's hiding something suspicious; a man entering with a commercial amount of Betta fish claims he's importing them for personal use, although the species is often bred for illegal fish fighting.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E10 — The Beetle's Live
A shipment of cardboard packing supplies hides a lethal secret, and a laptop computer bag conceals a narcotic that even advanced technology has trouble identifying; agriculture specialists prevent a deadly pest from entering the country.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E03 — Bullet Points
An elite team prepares for the extradition of a cartel Sicario, or hit man wanted for murder in his home country; with the sale of guns and ammo strictly controlled in Mexico, cartels turn to America for the weapons to wage their wars.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E06 — No Secrets Allowed
A new recruit hoping for her first drug seizure strikes it lucky; an unlikely smuggler is caught with nearly $50,000 in cash; officers find a fuel tank that's got more than gas inside it; a bus is searched after a K9 alerts to a strange smell.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E02 — Cocaine Chihuahua
As a man attempts to cross the border, he is flagged as having an outstanding manslaughter warrant; officers discover a secret stash of cocaine hidden inside a tractor-trailer; a woman caught with prescription pills is suspected of drug dealing.

title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
description:
S01 E05 — The Twins
After a gunfight outside a bar ends with two dead, Grand Rapids detectives discover that twin brothers are involved; the twins claim self-defense.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E07 — Anderson County Jail
Anderson County, Tennessee, is federally recognized as an area affected by drug trafficking and gangs. With only one county jail, Sheriff Barker and his team combat crime while offering unique inmate reentry programs that reduce recidivism.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars

After joining forces, Sig and Jake set their boats on a collision course; crew tensions explode on the Time Bandit, leading Keith to lure Freddy back to the Wizard.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:

When the Time Bandit's freezer fails, John makes an emergency trip to St. George Island to feed his hungry crew. Sig and Jake lure crab to their own side of a maritime boundary.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:

A dream leads John to a crab hotspot, but a rival trawler shares the vision for filling its own massive nets; Keith's crew races to save the Wizard as seawater breaches the engine room; An erratic crane drags Clark across the deck.

description:
S02 E05 — Ain't Worth Dying For
As a record-breaking windstorm hits Wyoming, recovery crews work side by side in hurricane-force winds to right rolled semis and clear the interstate; an icy path around Utah Lake overturns a loaded dump truck.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E01 — Living Life on the Edge
A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E06 — The Midnight Storm
Big Al's Towing races the clock as a semi carrying an expensive frozen load overturns on I-80.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S13 E05 — Big Island Buyer Beware
A single mom watches her family's dream of a Big Island coffee farm fade; under threat from wild hogs, invasive bamboo and a lack of water, the Raneys must clear a path to survival.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S14 E05 — Raney Returns: Blistered on the Bayou
Marty returns to a once-swampy Louisiana homestead, now ravaged by scorching heat, drought, and deadly predators. With the family on the brink of collapse, he races to restore their water, protect the livestock, and keep them from losing it all.

description:

When their hillbilly scotch experiment flames out, Mark and Digger light a fire under their still hand, Kelly. Josh's lucrative 80-gallon moonshine order rides on Jerry's unproven vacuum still experiment. Mike devises a recipe to poach Jerry's buyer.

title: Moonshiners
description:

For America's 250th birthday, Tim and Tickle fulfill their patriotic duty making revolutionary-era shine. Digger questions Mark's attempt to replicate his great-granddaddy's sour corn whiskey. Josh and Jerry's best-laid plans blow up in their faces.

The annual blackjack tournament lures more than big money to the Nugget; it becomes an opportunity to nab notorious thieves.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E08 — Secrets of the Drug War
Going deeper while investigating the modern war on drugs, testing theories around the question: if the war is real, why are drug cartels more wealthy and powerful than ever?

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E06 — Invisible Weapon of War
Andrew tests a disturbing theory: is a secret, directed-energy weapon used in Venezuela the smoking gun behind unexplained attacks on U.S. government officials overseas?

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E01 — Mind-Controlled Assassin
A failed assassination unleashes claims of a mind-controlled gunman; Andrew investigates the CIA's legacy of MK-Ultra, and stages an experiment with mentalist Max Major.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E07 — Programmed by AI
Using a real-world test and expert insights, Andrew asks a frightening question; have we already crossed the dangerous point of no return where artificial intelligence is capable of independently manipulating our reality without us knowing it?

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E04 — Arctic UFOs
Norway's ice-cold Hessdalen Valley is one of the hottest spots for UFO activity in the world; Phil and Heather use tech searching for the truth behind the mysterious Hessdalen Lights.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E05 — Frozen Aliens
Phil and Heather continue their investigation into claims of alien activity in Norway's Hessdalen Valley, accompanied by reports of creatures visiting us on Earth; using the latest tech, they attempt first contact.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E10 — Welcome to the Real Derry
Stephen King's "IT" features scary locations based on actual landmarks in Bangor, Maine; when Heather and Phil learn that many of those sites have real-life ghost stories of their own, they must investigate the locals' claims for themselves.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E02 — Secrets of Sherwood Forest
Phil and Heather continue their investigation into the dark legend of Robin Hood in Nottingham, England; while exploring reports of hostile ghosts in a medieval prison and sinister pagan rituals in Sherwood Forest, the team uncovers shocking answers.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E04 — Ghosts of Guam
Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E03 — Curse of the Skinwalkers
A series of terrifying encounters in the Navajo Nation has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. With the help of a local expert, Phil and Heather journey deep into a cursed valley and investigate a cave that few dare to enter.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S08 E01 — Digging Into D-Day
Josh Gates travels to the D-Day battlefields and the beaches of Normandy where he joins investigators making history-changing discoveries; Josh uncovers secrets about the invasion, including a complex of Nazi bunkers as well as an unexploded bomb.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S16 E06 — Vanderbilt's Lost Steamship
Josh braves Nicaragua's croc-infested waters and snake-filled jungle to find the wreckage of the Orus; chasing Gold Rush-era fortune, Vanderbilt's ship crashed in rapids on its maiden attempt to create a new route between the Atlantic and Pacific.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E06 — Chasing Africa's Atlantis
Josh dives the waters off Tanzania to find a lost city and its fortunes, search ancient shipwrecks and uncover what could be the walls of a lost city that traded riches.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E06 — Searching for World War II's Lost Hero
Armed with a new eyewitness account and cutting-edge tech, Josh travels to Micronesia and dives the Pacific to find a lost P-47 Thunderbolt; piloted by an American hero, the plane took part in a daring raid during the final days of World War II.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Josh's Favorites: Lost City of the White Jaguar
Trekking deep into Mexico's narco-controlled jungles, Josh hunts for the last Mayan stronghold to ward off the Spanish conquistadors. He joins an expedition braving snakes, spiders and jaguars to uncover the legendary city of Sac Balam.

title: Monsters Inside Me
description:
S09 E02 — The Beach, the Bug and the Bite
A beach trip leaves worms burrowing under a teen's skin; a routine blood donation exposes a woman's hidden parasitic infection; a bout of searing pain leads an Alaskan fishing guide to suspect a worm has traveled from his stomach to his liver.
